lines.en: I run faster than the other one.
Every step is like chasing a deadline.
These legs have been altered.
I sprint low along the ground.
Grass blades snap at my feet.
Don't think you can shake me off.
I swerve around the fallen tree.
I can chase a long way without stopping.
The smell of cattle is ahead.
When I run, the wind changes.
My arms barely swing.
I've run this road a few times.
I leap the ditch.

lines.zh: 我追鸡的路线比追人熟。
lines.en: I know the path to chickens better than to people.
You can't catch up. Don't bother.
I run without a sound.
I slow to a stop, breathing easy.
My knuckles loosen one by one.
No need to chase right now.
I'm picking the next one.
Something is moving in the grass.
I'm not tired. Just pausing.
This body is built for distance.
I crouch, knees light.
The wind carries many smells.
I'm waiting for a better moment.
The other doppelganger is too slow.
I'm different from it.
I'll remember your face first.

lines.zh: 不过你可能不是第一个。
lines.en: But you may not be first.
Are you slower than a cow?
I'm watching, all right.
Your movements are panicky.
I prefer chasing things that run.
Take a step back and I won't chase.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，是从你那拿的。
lines.en: This face was taken from you.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，和牛不一样。
lines.en: Your scent is different from a cow's.
You don't have horns.
You hit my borrowed skin.
I stepped back and steadied fast.
The flesh dents, then swells back.
You're not slow.
I remember your angle.
The skin broke a little.
Fast on my feet, tight in my teeth.
Be faster if you want to catch me.
I'll return this later.
You've got me riled.
What you hold is too little, too late.
I'd rather eat something that moves.
That's not enough to lure me.
Put it down.
I'd rather chase something living.

lines.zh: 牛的味道比你手里的香。
lines.en: Cattle smell better than what's in your hand.
Holding it up almost makes me laugh.
I'm coming close. Don't shake.
Keep it for yourself.
I run faster than the original.

lines.zh: 我的肩顶住你，把你推回去。
lines.en: My shoulder stops you and pushes back.
Half a step back and I steady.

lines.zh: 我贴着地一滚，又站起来。
lines.en: I roll low along the ground and rise again.
Your shoulder hit my chest.
I casually tripped you.
Your foot didn't land solid.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，你就从旁边滑过。
lines.en: I shifted aside and you slid right past.
I run twice as fast as my kind.
I have more strength than you.

lines.zh: 我们撞得草叶都飞起来。
lines.en: Our clash sends grass blades flying.
One other is enough.
One skin like this is enough.
This body is busy chasing things.
Don't waste your time.
I'd rather run.
Hunting is more interesting.
You ask too many questions.
I turn and walk away.
Don't follow. I'm fast.
Another time.
I picked up the same one you did.
Heavier than expected.
You dropped it. Mine.
Iron scraps? Worthless.
I don't like shiny things.
I tuck it against my chest.
It was in my way.
I picked it up and threw it away.
Watch all you like. I don't care.
This can't feed me.

lines.zh: 你踩断的草茎还冒着汁。
lines.en: The grass you snapped still bleeds sap.
Your steps are over there.

lines.zh: 牛棚里的味道，我先挑一个。
lines.en: Among the barn smells, I pick one first.

lines.zh: 我的手臂伸得比看起来长。
lines.en: My arm reaches farther than it looks.
You turn too slowly.
I'm twice as fast as you.
You hit a stone and slowed.

lines.zh: 你数到三，我就在你面前。
lines.en: Count to three, and I'm before you.
Even the wind can't help you.
Your back is open.
I open my mouth; I have more teeth than you.

lines.zh: 我从树后走出来，不再躲。
lines.en: I step out from the tree, done hiding.
You run, I follow.

lines.zh: 我的脚步落在你半步后。
lines.en: My steps land half a step behind you.
Look back and I'm closer.

lines.zh: 我数着你还有几步能跑。
lines.en: I count how many steps you have left.
There's a ditch ahead.
Jumping it will cost you a beat.
I don't jump. I go around.
You've run into the trees.
The gaps are narrow enough for you.
You snapped a branch.
I heard it clear as day.
You can't get out of this circuit.
I hit you from the side.
The impact spun you half around.
This kick lands on your calf.
You nearly dropped to your knees.
I drive a knee into your flank.
You're hauled back.
I add an elbow.
Your hands can't hold the ground.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡住，另一只手抓你。
lines.en: I block with one hand, grab with the other.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的领口往上提。
lines.en: I grab your collar and lift.
I came running from over there.

lines.zh: 我跑得比普通二重身快。
lines.en: I run faster than a common doppelganger.

lines.zh: 你的位置，我从远处就看见。
lines.en: I saw where you stood from far off.
I stop and look at you.
This body is faster.
I don't intend to take it slow.
There's another smell in the wind.
Two directions. I choose you first.
My feet are still moving.
Don't expect me to stop.
Fire burns on my skin. It hurts.

lines.zh: 落地翻了半圈，我立刻站起。
lines.en: I landed in a half roll and stood at once.
I can't move fast in water.
The blast shoved me far.

lines.zh: 箭杆插进腿里，走路有点歪。
lines.en: An arrow shaft in my leg; I walk crooked.
The spell holds my feet.
Starving too long has made my legs weak.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整个人都僵住。
lines.en: Lightning struck and I locked up.

lines.zh: 这里跑不起来，脚下空的。
lines.en: I can't run here. Nothing underfoot.
